name: orca-pipeline
description: Three-role Orca pipeline (기획 → 기획검수 → 실행) on pinned agent sessions that survive across tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, review, and build on pinned Orca agent sessions
interface.longDescription: Runs work through a fixed three-role Orca pipeline — planner, reviewer, builder — pinning one agent terminal per role and reusing it across tasks via --terminal, instead of letting worker-start spawn a fresh session for every task. The planner and builder stay warm so context accumulates; the reviewer relaunches cold every time so it judges a plan it did not watch being written. Model ids and effort levels are discovered from each agent CLI's own configuration rather than hardcoded.
defaultPrompt: Run the discovery script before offering any model choice; never name a model from memory.
Pin each role's terminal handle on first launch and reuse it with --terminal for every later task.
Probe an explicit model before pinning a role on it — codex exec exits 0 even when the request failed.
